title: potentilla neumanniana var. hirsuta
intro: Potentilla neumanniana var. hirsuta, commonly known as Shrubby Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as its potential to treat gastrointestinal issues, and to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities, and exhibit hepatoprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla neumanniana var. hirsuta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
